p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485222/attempts/83275b2e45034ad1868f4c57ede5090a/system/state/workspace/programs/task-3d8e0950.py')
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
                if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == color:
                    for sr, sc in ((-dr, -dc), (dr, dc)):
                        rr, cc = (r, c) if (sr, sc) == (-dr, -dc) else (nr, nc)
                        while 0 <= rr + sr < h and 0 <= cc + sc < w:
                            rr, cc = rr + sr, cc + sc
                            if out[rr][cc] != background:
                                break
                            out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
'''
